title: Nine Chairs and One Piano
subtitle: 安排与布置 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安排与布置（生活与自我·计划与安排）
meta: 主题语境：安排与布置（生活与自我·计划与安排）　|　核心词汇：arrangement　|　正文 310 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 arrangement 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 my mother made ① an arrangement with the school: nine chairs on Tuesday, nothing on Thursday. The ② arrangement, meaning the plan and not the chairs, lasted four years and was never written down; an arrangement, she said, is a promise that has agreed to be practical. She said the practising was what made it a promise.

Every ③ arrangement she ever made was with somebody who could break it, and she said that was the only kind worth making. Their ④ arrangement with the man who owned the hall was nine pounds a year and one bottle; an arrangement, my father said, is a contract that has agreed not to call itself one. He said the bottle was the honest part.

My grandmother did the other thing with the word and meant ⑤ the arrangement of the flowers, nine in a vase, which she changed on Sundays. The ⑥ arrangement, meaning the order and not the agreement, is the only thing in a room that everybody sees and nobody mentions; an arrangement, she said, is how a thing stands when nobody is asking it to. She said a vase is judged on Sundays only.

By 1981 the  arrangement had changed twice and the chairs had not. The ⑦ arrangement she played on the piano in March was nine minutes long and had taken her a winter; an arrangement, my father said, is what you call it when you borrow somebody else's tune and admit it. He said she never did admit it.

The ⑧ arrangement I remember is the nine chairs, which were put out on the Tuesday and put away on the Wednesday. An  arrangement, my mother said in 1986, is the smallest thing two people can build together that neither of them owns; every arrangement, she said, ends the day somebody writes it down. She said that was why hers lasted four years.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 安排；约定（一项具体的协议）
B. n. 安排（指那个计划，与具体的物相对）
D. 固定搭配：make an arrangement 作出安排、约定
E. 固定搭配：the arrangement of the flowers 花的摆放
F. n. 布置；陈列（一屋东西呈现的秩序）
G. n. 安排（指九把椅子摆出来这件事）
H. n. 安排（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: The arrangement, meaning the plan and not the chairs
The arrangement, meaning the order and not the agreement
The arrangement she played on the piano

answers.why: make an arrangement 意为“作出安排、约定”，1977 年母亲和学校约定：星期二九把椅子，星期四没有。
arrangement 指“那个计划”，与具体的椅子相对，这个约定维持了四年，从来没写下来。
arrangement 为抽象总称，泛指“安排、约定这类事”，她作出的每一个约定都是和一个能毁约的人作的。
arrangement 意为“一项具体的约定”，他们和礼堂老板的约定是每年九镑外加一瓶酒。
the arrangement of the flowers 意为“花的摆放”，祖母说的是另一回事：花瓶里九枝花的插放，她每个星期天换一次。
arrangement 意为“布置、陈列”，指秩序而不是协议，它是屋里人人都看见、却没人提起的东西。
arrangement 意为“改编曲”，她三月在钢琴上弹的那首改编曲长九分钟，花了她一个冬天。
arrangement 指九把椅子摆出来这件事，我记得的就是那九把椅子，星期二摆出来，星期三收回去。
